note: Adapted from Silvestri 1914; the original is in Latin (Contribuzione alla conoscenza dei Termitidi e Termitofili dell'Africa occidentale. I. Termitidi, Bollettino del Laboratorio di Zoologia Generale e Agraria della R. Scuola Superiore d'Agricoltura in Portici 9). Type locality: Aburi, Gold Coast (present-day Ghana). Biology: the author collected two soldiers and two workers in galleries under a fallen log. The species is the type species of the new genus Orthotermes, and the genus characters are given together with a comparison with Basidentitermes. The original uses a comma as the decimal mark (e.g. 1,50 for 1.50 mm); this has been converted to a decimal point here. Pl. LXXIII figs. 1—10 (soldier head in front and lateral view, mandibles, the three pairs of legs, worker mandibles and the apex of the tibia of the second pair of legs) are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Genus characters (Orthotermes gen. nov.): the soldier head shape distinguishes it from Basidentitermes — there is a transverse impression in the middle of the frons and the anterior margin is deeply concave; the genus is also keyed out alongside Pericapritermes gen. nov. and Ceratotermes gen. nov. The soldier of this species is characterised by the low transverse impression on the frons, the posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum not concave, and the outer margin of the coxa of the first pair of legs bearing 3 spines.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body straw-yellow; head yellowish brown, rust-coloured, mandibles black. Head as in Pl. LXXIII figs. 1—2; antennae 13-segmented, segment 1 nearly twice as long as segment 3, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 and almost as long as segment 5. The posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum is not concave. Legs: first pair (Pl. LXXIII fig. 5) with 3 spines on the outer margin of the coxa, the inner margin of the tibia with 2—3 spine-like hairs and some other hairs; second pair (Pl. LXXIII fig. 6) with stout outer spines on the tibia. Abdominal tergites with very minute hairs (or very short hairs, shorter ones posteriorly) and a few rather short hairs posteriorly; sternites with shorter hairs, very short hairs and some longer hairs posteriorly. Measurements (mm): body length 3.9; head length 1.50, head width 0.78; mandible length 0.87; antennal length 1.20; hind tibia 0.65.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body straw-yellow, head yellowish white, the abdomen greyish from the food it contains. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 1 about 1/4 longer than segment 2, segment 2 twice as long as segment 3, segment 4 nearly 1/4 longer than segment 3 and nearly equal to segment 5. The anterior lobe of the pronotum is not concave. Legs as in the soldier. Abdominal tergites with shorter hairs and very short hairs, with some further hairs posteriorly. Measurements (mm): body length 3.2; head length 0.65, head width 0.68; antennal length 0.92; hind tibia 0.52.
